raw_response:
I will keep my farm centered on the wheat-maize rotation, because that is the most familiar and steady system for me in Quzhou and I have well irrigation to support it. Since I also grow cotton, I will split the 40 mu into 30 mu of wheat followed by summer maize on the same 30 mu, and 10 mu of cotton on separate land. I am 58 and farming alone, so I will not make the plan too complicated or too labor-heavy. I will use better seed on all crops because I care more about stable yield than saving a little on seed. For wheat, I will push fertilizer and water enough to secure a solid stand and grain filling. For maize after wheat, I will keep the field work simple with no-tillage to save labor and catch the season on time. For cotton, I will keep a smaller area because it takes more management and more spraying, but I still want some cash income from it. Overall, I will manage for stable output, manageable labor, and lower risk rather than chasing the absolute highest yield.
